36:3.en: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers

36:5.en: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful

36:6.ar: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمࣰ ا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
36:6.en: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware

36:7.ar: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
36:7.en: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe

36:8.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
36:8.en: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft

36:9.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
36:9.en: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see

36:10.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
36:10.en: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe

36:11.ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةࣲ وَأَجۡرࣲ كَرِيمٍ
36:11.en: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward

36:12.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
36:12.en: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register

36:13.ar: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:13.en: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it

36:14.ar: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثࣲ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
36:14.en: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you

36:15.ar: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
36:15.en: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies

36:16.ar: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:16.en: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you

36:17.en: And we are not responsible except for clear notification

36:18.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
36:18.en: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment

36:19.ar: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
36:19.en: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people

36:20.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلࣱ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
36:20.en: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers

36:21.ar: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
36:21.en: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided

36:22.ar: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
36:22.en: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned

36:23.ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرࣲّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
36:23.en: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me

36:24.ar: إِنِّيٓ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
36:24.en: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error

36:25.en: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me

36:26.ar: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
36:26.en: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

36:27.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
36:27.en: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored

36:28.ar: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندࣲ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
36:28.en: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so

36:29.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
36:29.en: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished

36:30.ar: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
36:30.en: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him

36:31.ar: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
36:31.en: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return

36:32.ar: وَإِن كُلࣱّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
36:32.en: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us

36:33.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبࣰّ ا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
36:33.en: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat

36:34.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣲ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
36:34.en: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs

36:35.ar: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
36:35.en: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful

36:36.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
36:36.en: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know

36:37.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
36:37.en: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness

36:38.ar: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرࣲّ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
36:38.en: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing

36:39.ar: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
36:39.en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk

36:40.ar: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلࣱّ فِي فَلَكࣲ يَسۡبَحُونَ
36:40.en: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming

36:41.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
36:41.en: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship

36:42.ar: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
36:42.en: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride

36:43.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
36:43.en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

36:44.ar: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
36:44.en: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time

36:45.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
36:45.en: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy

36:46.ar: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةࣲ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
36:46.en: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away

36:47.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
36:47.en: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error

36:48.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
36:48.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful

36:49.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
36:49.en: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing

36:50.ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةࣰ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
36:50.en: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return

36:51.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
36:51.en: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten

36:52.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
36:52.en: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth

36:53.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
36:53.en: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us

36:54.ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
36:54.en: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do

36:55.ar: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلࣲ فَٰكِهُونَ
36:55.en: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation

36:56.ar: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
36:56.en: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches

36:57.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
36:57.en: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

36:58.ar: سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبࣲّ رَّحِيمࣲ‏
36:58.en: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord

36:59.en: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals

36:60.ar: ۞أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:60.en: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy

36:61.en: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path

37:1.en: By those [angels] lined up in rows

37:3.en: And those who recite the message

37:5.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
37:5.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises

37:6.ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
37:6.en: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

37:7.ar: وَحِفۡظࣰ ا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ مَّارِدࣲ‏
37:7.en: And as protection against every rebellious devil

37:8.ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲ‏
37:8.en: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side

37:9.en: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment

37:10.ar: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱ‏
37:10.en: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness]

37:11.ar: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّازِبِۭ
37:11.en: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay

37:12.en: But you wonder, while they mock

37:13.en: And when they are reminded, they remember not

37:14.en: And when they see a sign, they ridicule

37:15.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
37:15.en: And say, "This is not but obvious magic

37:16.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
37:16.en: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected

37:18.en: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible

37:19.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
37:19.en: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing

37:20.en: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense

37:21.ar: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
37:21.en: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny

37:22.ar: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
37:22.en: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship

37:23.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
37:23.en: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

37:24.en: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned

37:25.en: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other

37:26.en: But they, that Day, are in surrender

37:27.en: And they will approach one another blaming each other

37:28.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
37:28.en: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right

37:29.en: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers

37:30.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا طَٰغِينَ
37:30.en: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people

37:31.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
37:31.en: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment]

37:32.en: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators

37:33.en: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment

37:34.en: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals

37:35.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
37:35.en: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant

37:36.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرࣲ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
37:36.en: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet

37:37.en: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers

37:38.en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment

37:39.ar: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
37:39.en: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do

37:40.en: But not the chosen servants of Allah

37:41.en: Those will have a provision determined

37:42.en: Fruits; and they will be honored

37:45.en: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring

37:46.en: White and delicious to the drinkers

37:47.ar: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
37:47.en: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated

37:48.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes

37:49.en: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected

37:50.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other

37:51.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينࣱ‏
37:51.en: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]

37:52.en: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

37:53.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
37:53.en: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed

37:54.en: He will say, "Would you [care to] look

37:55.en: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire

37:56.en: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me

37:57.ar: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
37:57.en: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell]

37:58.en: Then, are we not to die

37:59.ar: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
37:59.en: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished

37:60.en: Indeed, this is the great attainment

37:61.en: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work

38:1.en: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder

38:2.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةࣲ وَشِقَاقࣲ‏
38:2.en: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension

38:3.ar: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲ‏
38:3.en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape

38:4.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابٌ
38:4.en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar

38:5.ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهࣰ ا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابࣱ‏
38:5.en: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing

38:6.ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءࣱ يُرَادُ
38:6.en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended

38:7.ar: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
38:7.en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication

38:8.ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
38:8.en: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment

38:9.ar: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
38:9.en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower

38:10.ar: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
38:10.en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access

38:11.ar: جُندࣱ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
38:11.en: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]

38:12.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
38:12.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes

38:13.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
38:13.en: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies

38:14.ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
38:14.en: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified

38:15.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقࣲ‏
38:15.en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay

38:16.ar: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
38:16.en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account

38:17.ar: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38:17.en: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah]

38:18.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
38:18.en: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise

38:19.en: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises]

38:20.ar: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
38:20.en: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech

38:21.ar: ۞وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
38:21.en: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber

38:22.ar: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
38:22.en: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path

38:23.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعࣱ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةࣰ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
38:23.en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech

38:24.ar: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلࣱ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعࣰ اۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
38:24.en: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah]

38:25.ar: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
38:25.en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return

38:26.ar: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
38:26.en: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account

38:27.ar: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
38:27.en: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire

38:28.ar: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
38:28.en: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked

38:29.ar: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكࣱ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
38:29.en: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded

38:30.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38:30.en: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]

38:31.ar: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
38:31.en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses

38:32.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
38:32.en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]

38:33.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
38:33.en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks

38:34.ar: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدࣰ ا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
38:34.en: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned

38:35.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكࣰ ا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدࣲ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
38:35.en: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower

38:36.ar: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
38:36.en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed

38:37.en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver

38:38.en: And others bound together in shackles

38:39.ar: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
38:39.en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account

38:40.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
38:40.en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return

38:41.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبࣲ وَعَذَابٍ
38:41.en: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment

38:42.ar: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدࣱ وَشَرَابࣱ‏
38:42.en: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink

38:43.ar: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
38:43.en: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding

38:44.ar: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثࣰ ا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرࣰ اۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ‏
38:44.en: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]

38:45.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
38:45.en: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision

38:46.en: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter]

38:47.en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding

38:48.ar: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلࣱّ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
38:48.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding

38:49.ar: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرࣱۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
38:49.en: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return

38:50.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them

38:51.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ كَثِيرَةࣲ وَشَرَابࣲ‏
38:51.en: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink

38:52.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age

38:53.en: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account

38:54.ar: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
38:54.en: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion

38:55.en: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return

38:56.en: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place

38:57.en: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence

38:58.en: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds

38:59.ar: هَٰذَا فَوۡجࣱ مُّقۡتَحِمࣱ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
38:59.en: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire

38:60.ar: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
38:60.en: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement

38:61.ar: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا ضِعۡفࣰ ا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
38:61.en: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire

36:62.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلࣰّ ا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
36:62.en: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason

36:63.en: This is the Hellfire which you were promised

36:64.en: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny

36:68.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
36:68.en: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand

36:69.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ وَقُرۡءَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:69.en: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

36:70.ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيࣰّ ا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
36:70.en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers

36:71.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمࣰ ا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
36:71.en: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners

36:72.ar: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
36:72.en: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat

36:73.ar: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
36:73.en: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful

36:74.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
36:74.en: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped

36:75.ar: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
36:75.en: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance

36:76.ar: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
36:76.en: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare

36:77.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةࣲ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
36:77.en: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary

36:78.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلࣰ ا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمࣱ‏
36:78.en: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated

36:79.ar: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةࣲۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
36:79.en: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing

36:80.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارࣰ ا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
36:80.en: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite

36:81.ar: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
36:81.en: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator

36:82.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
36:82.en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is

36:83.ar: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
36:83.en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned

37:75.en: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders

37:76.en: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction

37:77.en: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

37:78.en: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

37:79.en: Peace upon Noah among the worlds

37:80.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

37:81.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants

37:83.en: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham

37:84.en: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

37:85.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
37:85.en: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship

37:86.en: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire

37:87.en: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds

37:88.en: And he cast a look at the stars

37:89.en: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill

37:90.en: So they turned away from him, departing

37:91.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
37:91.en: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat

37:92.en: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak

37:93.en: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand

37:94.en: Then the people came toward him, hastening

37:95.en: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve

37:96.en: While Allah created you and that which you do

37:97.ar: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنࣰ ا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
37:97.en: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire

37:98.ar: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدࣰ ا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
37:98.en: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased

37:99.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
37:99.en: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me

37:100.en: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous

37:101.en: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy

37:102.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
37:102.en: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast

37:103.en: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead

37:105.ar: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
37:105.en: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

37:106.en: Indeed, this was the clear trial

37:107.en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice

37:108.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

37:110.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

37:111.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants

37:112.ar: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيࣰّ ا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
37:112.en: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous

37:113.ar: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنࣱ وَظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينࣱ‏
37:113.en: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself

37:114.en: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron

37:115.en: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction

37:116.en: And We supported them so it was they who overcame

37:117.en: And We gave them the explicit Scripture

37:118.en: And We guided them on the straight path

37:119.en: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations

37:121.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

37:122.en: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants

37:123.en: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers

37:124.en: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah

37:125.ar: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلࣰ ا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
37:125.en: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators

37:126.en: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers

37:127.en: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment]

37:128.en: Except the chosen servants of Allah

37:129.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations

37:131.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good

37:132.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants

37:133.en: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers

37:134.en: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all

37:135.en: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers]

37:137.en: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

37:138.en: And at night. Then will you not use reason

37:139.en: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers

37:140.en: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship

37:141.en: And he drew lots and was among the losers

37:142.en: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy

37:143.en: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah

37:144.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
37:144.en: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected

37:145.en: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill

37:146.en: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine

37:147.ar: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
37:147.en: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more

37:148.en: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time

37:167.en: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say

37:168.ar: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
37:168.en: If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples

37:169.en: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah

37:170.en: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know

37:171.en: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers

37:172.en: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

37:173.en: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome

37:174.en: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time

37:175.en: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see

37:176.en: Then for Our punishment are they impatient

37:177.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
37:177.en: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned

37:178.en: And leave them for a time

37:179.en: And see, for they are going to see

37:180.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
37:180.en: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe

37:182.en: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds

38:71.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرࣰ ا مِّن طِينࣲ‏
38:71.en: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay

38:72.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
38:72.en: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration

38:73.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely

38:74.ar: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
38:74.en: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers

38:75.ar: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
38:75.en: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty

38:76.ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارࣲ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينࣲ‏
38:76.en: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay

38:77.en: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled

38:78.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
38:78.en: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense

38:79.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ

XfRMTzmyYpk.speaker: adnan
XfRMTzmyYpk.speaker_note: his A Juz A Day Ramadan series; same format and voice as other episodes
XfRMTzmyYpk.title: A Juz A Day: Juz 23, Being Optimistic and Learning from Mistakes
XfRMTzmyYpk.one_line: Ya-Sin teaches optimism in dawah, as-Saffat that Allah's warnings come true, and Sad how prophets erred and were corrected.
XfRMTzmyYpk.summary: He covers Ya-Sin, as-Saffat and Sad. In Ya-Sin the Prophet is told that many will not listen, yet there is always reason for optimism: results belong to Allah, and the man who came running from the far end of the city, believed, was killed and still wished his people well shows that even one believer is enough. He walks through the signs of the revived earth, pairs in creation and the ordered orbits of sun and moon, arguing that admiring creation must lead to thanking Allah and certainty of resurrection, with the trumpet blasts and the scenes of paradise. In as-Saffat, whose short bursting verses aim to wake people, the theme is that Allah's threats are fulfilled; he highlights the companion in paradise who nearly was ruined by a doubting friend, a lesson about the influence of the people around us, and the prophets Allah rewarded, especially Ibrahim consulting his son and Yunus showing the door of tawbah is open. In Sad he focuses on prophets' errors of judgment: Dawud ruling before hearing both sides, Sulayman distracted by his horses, Ayyub's rash oath. Each repented and remained honoured, unlike Iblis, whose refusal was defiance, not a mistake. He asks the audience to learn from mistakes and give others room to grow.

outline.heading: Juz 23 and the last seventh of the Quran
outline.gist: The juz spans Ya-Sin, as-Saffat, Sad and the start of az-Zumar, entering the final seventh the companions used for weekly completion.

outline.heading: Ya-Sin opens: warning a heedless people
outline.gist: Many will not believe as if shackled and veiled; the Prophet's task is only to warn.

outline.heading: Reason for optimism: numbers do not matter
outline.gist: Keep calling everyone; those who follow the reminder will respond, and a small number is still success.

outline.heading: The town and its three messengers
outline.gist: Results are in Allah's hands; the dawah was reinforced with a third messenger despite rejection.

outline.heading: The man from the far end of the city
outline.gist: He argues for worshipping the One who created him; Allah is the Lord of all, not one team's god.

outline.heading: Killed, entering paradise, wishing his people knew
outline.gist: A true caller holds no grudge even against his killers; one believer is reason enough to continue.

outline.heading: Destroyed generations and the dead earth revived
outline.gist: Life and death as reasons to take heed; Allah brings barren land to life with grain and gardens.

outline.heading: Enjoy the blessings and thank Allah
outline.gist: We do not make food grow; reminders of provision aim at enjoyment with gratitude, not guilt.

outline.heading: Everything created in pairs
outline.gist: Uniform design and diverse forms point to one planner.

outline.heading: Night, sun and moon each in its orbit
outline.gist: Order and harmony from the cosmos to the atom cannot be coincidence.

outline.heading: Ships, mercy at sea, and why creation is paired with resurrection
outline.gist: Admiring creation must lead to recognizing the Creator, thanking Him and being certain of resurrection.

outline.heading: The two trumpet blasts
outline.gist: The first blast ends all life, the second raises everyone at once.

outline.heading: The people of paradise and the question to the children of Adam
outline.gist: Peace as a greeting from the Lord, and the reminder that Satan is a sworn enemy.

outline.heading: Long life reversed: life is temporary
outline.gist: Decline in old age shows life is temporary and resurrection true.

outline.heading: Not poetry: a warning to the truly alive
outline.gist: A person is truly alive when their heart accepts reminders and changes.

outline.heading: Cattle subjected to us; idols that cannot help
outline.gist: Huge animals made easy for human benefit, while pagans guard idols that do nothing for them.

outline.heading: Do not let their words grieve you
outline.gist: The Prophet was saddened by people who knew him turning into enemies; it was not his fault.

outline.heading: Created from a drop, so He can revive bones
outline.gist: The Creator of the cosmos easily resurrects; He says be and it is.

outline.heading: As-Saffat's style: short verses in bursts
outline.gist: The rhythm is meant to wake the listener.

outline.heading: Allah's threats will be fulfilled; oaths by the angels
outline.gist: The Lord of the heavens and of every point of sunrise.

outline.heading: Mockery of resurrection and the single blast
outline.gist: When they rise it is too late to believe.

outline.heading: Detain them for questioning
outline.gist: The wrongdoers and what they worshipped are gathered, unable to help one another.

outline.heading: A mad poet? Character assassination when the message cannot be refuted
outline.gist: The Prophet had no history of poetry; slander replaces argument.

outline.heading: The pure drink of paradise
outline.gist: Unlike alcohol it neither harms nor intoxicates.

outline.heading: The companion who doubted resurrection
outline.gist: A person in paradise sees his former friend in hell and says he nearly ruined him.

outline.heading: The influence of the people around us
outline.gist: Friends and those we look up to shape how we see the world; be cautious of who influences you.

outline.heading: Nuh and the repeated refrains
outline.gist: Four phrases recur for each prophet: delivered, honourable mention, peace upon him, this is how we reward the good.

outline.heading: Ibrahim breaks the idols and is thrown in the fire
outline.gist: His logic was answered with violence, and Allah saved him.

outline.heading: Ibrahim always on the move
outline.gist: A comfort for those whose lives keep moving them from place to place.

outline.heading: Ibrahim consults his son about the dream
outline.gist: Asking his son's view of a divine command builds self-esteem and respect in the young.

outline.heading: The ransom and Ibrahim's double honour
outline.gist: The test is passed and the refrain of reward is said twice for Ibrahim alone.

outline.heading: Musa and Harun
outline.gist: Saved, guided and honoured.

outline.heading: Ilyas and the idol Ba'l
outline.gist: Those who answered his call were spared.

outline.heading: Lut and the ruins on the trade route
outline.gist: Makkans passed Sodom's ruins on their journeys yet did not reflect.

outline.heading: Yunus: the runaway on the overloaded ship
outline.gist: He left before being permitted; his constant glorification saved him from the whale.

outline.heading: Yunus's people believed: the door of tawbah is open
outline.gist: Over a hundred thousand believed and the punishment was lifted.

outline.heading: Messengers will be helped; turn away for a while
outline.gist: Do not engage fruitlessly with mockery, but keep preaching.

outline.heading: Closing praise of as-Saffat
outline.gist: Glory to Allah and peace upon the messengers.

outline.heading: Sad: prophets' mistakes and how Allah corrects them
outline.gist: The surah's distinctive thread: errors of judgment and the lessons drawn.

outline.heading: Has he made the gods one? A scheme for power
outline.gist: The chiefs accuse the Prophet of seeking power and ask why he was chosen.

outline.heading: Do they own the treasuries of Allah's mercy?
outline.gist: They have no right to decide whom Allah chooses.

outline.heading: Dawud, the man of strength
outline.gist: Mountains and birds glorified with him; he was given kingship and wisdom.

outline.heading: The two litigants: Dawud rules before hearing both sides
outline.gist: Swayed by the numbers 99 and one, he judged too fast, then repented and was forgiven.

outline.heading: Judge with truth, not desire
outline.gist: Authority brings responsibility; do not be overwhelmed by the optics of an argument.

outline.heading: Creation is not without purpose; contemplate the book
outline.gist: The Quran's purpose is reflection that leads to realization and implementation, not ritual alone.

outline.heading: Sulayman distracted by his horses
outline.gist: He missed the prayer, repented and made amends, and remained close to Allah.

outline.heading: Ayyub's rash oath and the bundle of grass
outline.gist: A sick man's regretted oath fulfilled without harming his wife, and his family restored twofold.

outline.heading: Everybody makes mistakes; not all mistakes are equal
outline.gist: Ayyub was overwhelmingly patient; other prophets are named among the chosen.

outline.heading: Iblis: defiance, not a mistake
outline.gist: He questioned Allah's judgment and blamed Allah, unlike prophets who erred and repented.

outline.heading: Learning from mistakes and reconciling
outline.gist: Prophets' errors make them role models of repentance; we should grow from our mistakes and allow others to.

outline.heading: Outro

themes.note: The trumpet blasts, paradise and the questioning of humanity.

themes.label: Brotherhood, companionship and friendship
themes.note: A doubting friend nearly ruined a man of paradise; guard who influences you.

themes.label: Stories of earlier prophets

themes.note: Prophets' errors of judgment were corrected and forgiven; Iblis's defiance was different.

themes.note: Hear both sides and judge by truth, not desire or optics.

themes.label: Parenting and raising children
themes.note: Ibrahim asks his son's opinion to build his self-esteem.

maxims: The results are in the hands of Allah
It's not a team sport: your god versus my god
Enjoy the pleasures and thank Allah
If you cannot refute the message, you attack the messenger
Not all mistakes are the same

stories.who: The man from the far end of the city
stories.point: Even one believer justifies optimism; true callers carry no grudge.

stories.who: The companion in paradise and his doubting friend
stories.point: The people we keep close shape our destiny.
Consult the young to build their respect and self-esteem.
The door of tawbah remains open.
Never judge before hearing both sides.
Mistakes said in suffering can be resolved without harm.
Defiance of Allah is not the same as an error of judgment.

takeaways: Keep doing dawah without measuring success by numbers.
Enjoy Allah's blessings and consciously thank Him for them.
Choose carefully the friends and voices that influence how you see the world.
Hear both sides before judging any dispute.
Own your mistakes, repent and grow, and let others do the same.

inklXsig4po.title: Ramadan 2026, Night 21: Tahajjud
inklXsig4po.one_line: Two tahajjud reminders: the prayer is divided between Allah and His servant, and the standing is an act of reverence that deserves the most time.
inklXsig4po.summary: On the twenty-first night the sheikh's short reminders between the rakaat continue a look at the prayer posture by posture. In the first he says every position of salah has an outward form and an inner meaning, and that the prayer is shared: half of it belongs to Allah and half to the worshipper. He grounds this in the hadith qudsi where Allah says He has divided the prayer between Himself and His servant and answers each verse of al-Fatiha in turn: praise, glorification, the shared pledge of worship and seeking help, and finally the servant's own request for guidance, which Allah grants. The better a person understands prayer this way, the more he puts into the part that is for Allah. He asks the congregation to be absorbed in the purpose of each movement while they perform it. In the second reminder he turns to the first movement, the standing. Citing the teaching that the best prayer is the one with the longest standing, he compares it to students rising when their teacher walks in: an act of reverence and respect that also shows they accept what they are about to be taught, since the standing is where Allah's guidance and rulings are recited. He calls it the most important part of the prayer and urges people to give it unhurried time.

outline.heading: Interlude
Every posture has a form and a spirit; the prayer is shared with Allah
outline.gist: Each position in salah carries a meaning beyond the movement, and the prayer is split: half for Allah and half for the servant. Seeing it this way makes you invest more in the half that is His.

outline.heading: Hadith qudsi: I have divided the prayer between Me and My servant
outline.gist: Allah responds to each verse of al-Fatiha: He is praised, He is glorified, the pledge of worship and seeking help is shared, and the request for guidance belongs to the servant and is granted.

outline.heading: Be absorbed in the purpose of each movement
outline.gist: In every movement, stay preoccupied with what that movement is for and invest in what it actually means.

outline.heading: Interlude
The best prayer is the one with the longest standing
outline.gist: He opens the discussion of the first movement, the standing, with the Prophet's teaching that the finest prayer is the one with long standing.

outline.heading: Standing like a student when the teacher enters
outline.gist: Students rise for their teacher out of reverence and respect, and to show they accept and will take in what is taught. The standing in prayer is that posture before Allah, where His guidance and rulings are recited.

outline.heading: Give the standing the most time
outline.gist: The standing is by far the most important part of the prayer; the more you invest in it, the more you take from the whole prayer, so give it proper, unhurried time.

outline.heading: Interlude
Outro

quran.point: The verses of al-Fatiha as Allah divides them between Himself and the servant in the hadith qudsi.

hadith.gist: Allah says: I have divided the prayer between Myself and My servant into two halves, and My servant shall have what he asks. When he says 'All praise is for Allah' Allah says My servant has praised Me; at 'the Most Merciful' He says My servant has extolled Me; at 'Master of the Day of Judgment' He says My servant has glorified Me; at 'You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help' He says this is between Me and My servant; at 'Guide us to the straight path' He says this is for My servant and he shall have what he asked.
The best prayer is the one with the longest standing.

maxims: Half of the prayer is for Him and half is for you
takeaways: Treat each posture of salah as having its own purpose and keep your mind on that purpose while performing it.
Recite al-Fatiha aware that Allah is answering each verse as you say it.
Put your effort first into the part of the prayer that is for Allah: His praise and glorification.
Lengthen the standing and slow it down; it is the most important part of the prayer.
